title: [Windows-WSL]Published Ports not reachable via localhost
body:
### Issue Description

After upgrading to Podman 6 it is not possible to reach published ports via localhost on host machine. I tested rootful and rootless with the same results.

Inside the VM and via the VM-IP directly the ports are reachable, so it seems to be on the port remapping.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Upgrade/Install to Podman 6 on Windows
2. Start a container with a published port
3. Try to access


### Describe the results you received

I get 'Connection refused' while trying to connect the published port via localhost.

### Describe the results you expected

Connect successfully to the published port
